name: Spiritual Walfare
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are empowered by Christ to overcome spiritual adversaries, as Jesus grants authority over the enemy's forces to protect and prevail (Luke 10:19). This victory is rooted in relying on God's strength and might rather than our own (Ephesians 6:10). Furthermore, a vital aspect of spiritual warfare involves submitting fully to God and actively resisting the devil, which results in the enemy fleeing from the believer (James 4:7). Together, these verses emphasize that spiritual warfare is both a divine empowerment and a call to steadfast obedience and resistance against evil.
